executionPolicy.proofLayer: Execute production helpers for state/variant depth; native tests for layout/input/occlusion; inspected originals for material fidelity; matched full-app measurement for performance.
executionPolicy.profiles: Map representative primary/fallback font, forced-colors/opaque fallback, reduced motion/mute, short/narrow/landscape,200%text and actual browser zoom to affected questions; do not form a blanket cross-product.
executionPolicy.reuse: One coherent workflow may close multiple related rows only with exact evidence/revision and accepted unchanged consumer closure.
executionPolicy.CI: Only exact current-head PR validation/pr-gate is blocking CI. Nightly remains advisory.
executionPolicy.retained: No blanket new retained stage for material-only rows; preserve and qualify affected state boundaries separately.
executionPolicy.review: Independent UX/product/performance review closes concrete findings on final combined source, not all rows by screenshot count.
executionPolicy.newScope: HomeYou label policy and incoming-move placement/reservation changes excluded until studies confirmed.
executionPolicy.deferred: D16 automatic endings, PR85/124/131/168 and Slate remain separately visible follow-ups. V31 verifies existing delivered surface only.
